export interface ValidationReport { status: string; checks: string[]; }
export function summarizeReport(report: ValidationReport) { return report.checks.join(','); }

export type ValidationProvider = 'command' | 'bdd' | 'contract-test';
export function providerName(provider: ValidationProvider) { return provider; }

export function projectValidation(report: unknown) { return JSON.stringify(report); }
export const evidenceRefs = true;

export interface UserFacingClaim { text: string; verified: boolean; }
export const provenance = 'repository-context';

export async function verifyTask() { return { status: 'PASS' }; }
export const reportPath = '.harness/reports';

export function startOperation() { return 'operation'; }
export const taskContract = true;

export function informationalTurn() { return 'read-only'; }
export const lifecycle = false;
